problem:

$$
r=⟨1-5t,{e}^{2t}⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the velocity vector $v$ at time $t=1.$

Question 6
?

The position vector r of a particle P (relative to a fixed origin O) at time t is given by r=⟨1−5t,e2t⟩,t>0. Calculate the velocity vector v at time t=1.

a
v(1)=⟨−4,2e⟩
b
v(1)=⟨−4,2e2⟩
c
v(1)=⟨−5,2e2⟩
d
v(1)=⟨−5,e2⟩
e
v(1)=⟨−5,2e⟩
